capSemanticsReview.rationale: Pinned ethereum block 26113624 (hash 0xa8237b00d3c3b45acd6b8c3284c68a98037052ea7447b7674ce460b207a33ca2). The pinned SavingFxUSD implementation uses ERC4626 _deposit with safeTransferFrom before _mint; depositGauge likewise transfers gauge receipts before minting. Parameter changes affect deposit/redemption and investment settings, not an arbitrary share mint. The AladdinDAO TimelockController can replace implementation through ProxyAdmin, but upgrade-only authority is outside the unchanged D14 trigger; under the currently verified implementation, raising limits admits only asset-funded deposits. Inherited controls concern fxusd-f-x-protocol, whose parent issuance is carried by the serial-claim dependency, not wrapper-local D14.

mintAuthority.summary: fxSAVE is a strategy-vault receipt over f(x) Protocol's fxUSD savings strategy; shares are minted against deposited fxUSD and do not create base fxUSD supply, so its mint authority is inherited from fxUSD (fxusd-f-x-protocol). Wrapper upgrade is guarded by a ProxyAdmin whose owner is an AladdinDAO TimelockController with a 3-day delay.

controls.label: f(x) fxSAVE vault receipt token
controls.capDescription: fxSAVE shares are minted/burned by the f(x) saving vault against fxUSD deposits and redemptions; this share accounting cannot create or destroy base fxUSD supply.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25573280: asset() returned 0x65c9a641afceb9c0e6034e558a319488fa0fa3be (fxUSD Stability Pool); EIP-1967 implementation slot = 0xe4031e271809d20074e4bef1caeefec5f710e8a6 and admin slot = ProxyAdmin 0x9b54b7703551d9d0ced177a78367560a8b2edda4. The receipt shares are minted and burned only through the vault's fxUSD deposit and redemption accounting.

controls.label: AladdinDAO 3-day TimelockController (fxSAVE ProxyAdmin owner)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25573280, the fxSAVE EIP-1967 admin was ProxyAdmin 0x9b54b7703551d9d0ced177a78367560a8b2edda4; ProxyAdmin.owner() returned this TimelockController, whose getMinDelay() returned 259200 seconds. It can replace the vault implementation only after the three-day delay.

controls.label: Inherited fxUSD CDP mint path
controls.capDescription: Underlying fxUSD is minted only against overcollateralized wstETH/WBTC CDP positions inside f(x) Protocol; fxSAVE cannot create base fxUSD outside that parent path.
controls.evidence: The separately reviewed fxUSD parent establishes this collateralized CDP mint path at Ethereum block 25294712. fxSAVE holds the fxUSD Stability Pool receipt and inherits that base-asset authority; it has no separate off-protocol issuer minter.

review.evidence: fxSAVE (variantOf fxusd-f-x-protocol, variantKind strategy-vault) is a yield-bearing vault receipt over fxUSD. At Ethereum block 25573280, asset() confirmed the fxUSD Stability Pool and the proxy chain resolved to ProxyAdmin 0x9b54b7703551d9d0ced177a78367560a8b2edda4 owned by TimelockController 0x68863fb8855b04509a835082478d6e3d0be4e61a with a 259200-second minimum delay. No privileged share mint outside deposit accounting was found; changing that accounting requires the delayed upgrade path. The wrapper has no issuer reserve or named prudential supervisor of its own.
